decision.summary: The Fed held its policy rate at 1.75%. The vote was 10-2. Dissenting: Edward M. Gramlich, Robert D. McTeer, Jr..

changes.quote: The information that has become available since the last meeting of the Committee suggests that aggregate demand is growing at a moderate pace.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

changes.quote: Over time, the current accommodative stance of monetary policy, coupled with still robust underlying growth in productivity, should be sufficient to foster an improving business climate.
changes.explanation: Reworded from the previous statement: “The current accommodative stance of monetary policy, coupled with still-robust underlying growth in productivity, should be sufficient to foster an improving bu…”

changes.quote: However, considerable uncertainty persists about the extent and timing of the expected pickup in production and employment owing in part to the emergence of heightened geopolitical risks.
changes.explanation: New language added in this statement.

changes.quote: Consequently, the Committee believes that, for the foreseeable future, against the background of its long-run goals of price stability and sustainable economic growth and of the information currently available, the risks are weighted mainly toward conditions that may generate economic weakness.

tone_quotes.quote: Consequently, the Committee believes that, for the foreseeable future, against the background of its long-run goals of price stability and sustainable economic growth and of the information currently available, the risks are weighted mainly toward conditions that may generate economic weakness.
Over time, the current accommodative stance of monetary policy, coupled with still robust underlying growth in productivity, should be sufficient to foster an improving business climate.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 13.53% APR costs about $56.38 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 3.69% and moved -1 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.18% would fall by about $1.94 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 5.7%, and employers added an average of -17k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 1.7% over the past year (August 2002); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 1.7%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 2.5% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved 0 bp on the day.

whats_next: The dictionary tone reading is dovish (leaning toward lower rates).

citations.detail: The Federal Open Market Committee decided today to keep its target for the federal funds rate unchanged at 1 3/4 percent.
